title: Asthama Camp
summary: Asthama Camp was held on the Sharad Poornima night on the grounds of the Rajawadi.
description: Asthama Camp was held on the Sharad Poornima night on the grounds of the Rajawadi. Asthma patients assemble under the full moon to take benefit from the special Unani medicine given by the specialists. The medicine is boiled in milk under the moon rays whole night and given to patients early in the morning Patients come to attend this Camp from far off places like Dombivili, Nalasopara, Panvel and even Nasik. The medicine has given relief to hundreds of chronic asthma patients over the years. Similar Camp was also held at Vikroli and Nakhatrana in Kutch. Beneficaries- Ghatkopar – 500 Vikhroli – 400 Nakhatrana, Kutch - 22500
